alerts.title: Live: Houthis advance in Yemen as tankers hit sea mines in Strait of Hormuz
alerts.why: Tanker strikes in the Strait of Hormuz threaten vital crude supply chokepoints, triggering severe geopolitical risk premiums.

itemsSent.title: Maersk, Hapag-Lloyd Expand Suez Canal Return With Three More Gemini Services
itemsSent.why: Return to Suez Canal shortens voyage times, lowering bunker fuel demand and easing supply chain friction, putting mild downward pressure on crude.

itemsSent.title: Saudi Arabia dismisses commander of coalition forces fighting Houthis
itemsSent.why: Red Sea military reshuffle and tactical withdrawal suggest lingering security risks, though immediate supply disruptions remain limited.

itemsSent.title: Oil prices fall as Mideast supply recovery outweighs Iran risks
itemsSent.why: Recovering Middle East exports and expected global supply surplus outweighing Iran risks, pushing Brent down.

itemsSent.title: India Wholesale Inflation Highest in 4 Years
itemsSent.why: Indian wholesale fuel and crude inflation hit a four-year high, signaling strong domestic energy demand despite rising costs.

itemsSent.title: Japan Q3 GDP Unexpectedly Stalls
itemsSent.why: Japan Q3 GDP stalled and private consumption fell, signaling weaker economic momentum and lower energy demand from the world's fourth-largest oil importer.

itemsSent.title: ONE Joins Maersk, Hapag, and Others in Return to Suez Canal
itemsSent.why: Return to Suez Canal shortens voyage times, lowering global shipping fuel demand and easing supply chain logistics concerns.
